source: Iced-Cream's own tests on their unit, recorded in rytm2_mods ctrl-all/README.md at afd461d and the C3A4 unit test
statement: Hardware, OS 1.74: in R8K4 (2026-10-19) ctrl-all 1.2's tests 1 to 4 pass: TRK + FRQ moves FRQ on another track by the same amount; on the SYNTH page with BD HARD on track 1 and SD HARD on track 2 every knob pairs by its place on the screen, and a machine with an empty knob stays put; TRK + TYP sets every track's type; with the FX track selected or a trig key held only the selected track changes. In C3A4 (core-ar2 0.3 and all eleven rytm2_mods v1.2 ports, 2026-10-20) each mod's own test passed, including this one's.
scope: ctrl-all 1.2 beside other rytm2_mods ports, never alone. No build with the released core-ar2 0.3 has run on a unit with it yet.

builds.label: C3A4
builds.content: core-ar2 0.3 as built before elekloader #153, and rytm2_mods v1.2's eleven OS 1.74 release objects. Relinking those files on stock 1.74 gives this main OS byte for byte.
results: Each mod's own test passed, including Ctrl All's.

builds.label: R8K4
builds.content: core-ar2 0.1 ported to 1.74 with filter-hz, ctrl-all 1.2 (rytm2_mods 7508487), env-reset-amp, slice-loop, main-rms, comp-preview and kit-ab.
results: Test 1: TRK + FRQ on the FILTER page moves another track's FRQ by the same amount.
Test 2: SYNTH page, BD HARD (track 1) and SD HARD (track 2): every knob pairs by its place on the screen; a machine with an empty knob stays put.
Test 3: TRK + TYP: every track takes the type the selected track reaches.
Test 4: with the FX track selected, or a trig key held, only the selected track changes.

individualTestResults: FILTER FRQ follows on another track
SYNTH knobs pair by screen position across BD HARD and SD HARD
FILTER TYP set on every track
FX track and held trig key stay single-track

contextNote: Main OS hashes are the builds', not read back from the device. Modwerk links the released core-ar2 0.3 (6b97dfb3…, with #153), which differs from C3A4's core.
